rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with a single dominant stepped bar/landform, and it stays legible in all four views. The silhouette is not just arbitrary stair-stepping; it reads as one continuous terraced mass, so silhouette resolution is acceptable. It responds reasonably to the parcel boundary by sitting within it and preserving a clear figure-ground relationship, though the open-space figure is weak. The main weakness is access: the thick blue frontage edge is not answered by a convincing public void, entry seam, or undercut, and the carved cave is closed rather than explicitly aligned to the access side. Programmatically, the mass can plausibly support neighborhood living as a compact street building, but it still feels more like a generic stepped object than a fully resolved active-ground mixed-use section. Overall: passable, with the main repair being a more legible public threshold toward the frontage.
